provenance.sequence_source: Chen et al. 2013 (PMID 23727987), Supplementary Table 3 (synthetic terminators), L3S2P11, identical over 57 bp: an engineered terminator, sequence from the defining publication; no GenBank record was found to carry it. Until 2026-11 the part held a modified form differing at positions 1, 5, 23 and 57 (named '(modified) RF L3S2P11 terminator'); it is now the published design.
